adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately calls `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without handling `host == nil`, which will raise `NoMethodError` on stale/invalid ids. Additionally, `save_host` unconditionally reads `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]`; if `params[:embeddable_host]` is missing/malformed this will also raise. Separately, `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` even when `self.host` is nil, so a missing `host` param can crash during validation instead of returning a normal validation error.
